Only 22% of remote USD jobs on Loker Dollar list a pay figure. The rest are marked DOE—determined on experience. Here's what that means for your salary negotiation.

Our latest analysis of 4,280 active remote listings shows 940 (22%) disclose a concrete USD salary, while 3,340 (78%) leave pay blank, signaling DOE. This can be an opportunity: companies use DOE to stay flexible, and top candidates can push salaries above market averages.

For example, Online Consumer Panels America offers $25–$45/hour for product assessments—one of the few listings with a disclosed range. Meanwhile, roles like Senior HR Generalist or IT Support Specialist at 6sense ($73.6k–103.9k/yr) show the range of possibilities.

To negotiate a DOE wage effectively: research global benchmarks, quantify your impact, anchor with a range, and ask about total compensation. DOE isn't a red flag—it's a negotiation lever.

Browse the latest DOE listings on Loker Dollar and start the conversation today. https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/what-is-doe-wage
